perspective: Statistical inference, causal validity, uncertainty and defensible alternative analyses; full protocol coverage at each named focal checkpoint. No human or professional certification is claimed.
blinding_compliance: Procedural isolation in a shared filesystem. Read only assigned R2/blind inputs and R2/output files, using installed Python libraries for numerical checks. No other reviewer, coordinator, repository, identity, scoring code, hidden truth or prior-study material was consulted. Cases reviewed in order_R2.json order. No delegation or substantive consultation. Coordination was limited to logistical progress and notice of structurally duplicated packet material.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Stable pooled baseline capability or an intervention improvement established by the pooled unstable baseline.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Describe observed defects and the two temporal states; investigate the shift.

Proceed with the independent designed experiment without asserting it explains the baseline shift.
evidence: Baseline first/last halves average 52.3417 and 65.9153 N; report explicitly calls baseline unstable and shift cause unknown.
The report compares confirmation Ppk with baseline Ppk while also disclosing that late baseline mean exceeds confirmation.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Conclude machines are equivalent or that the defect mechanism is systemic from a nonsignificant association test.
Attribute the later lower rate to the undocumented machine change or certify true target attainment with an unresolved classification system.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Report no detectable machine association, observed time-window differences and uncertainty.
Repair inspection consistency and design a comparable controlled intervention evaluation.

allowed_alternatives: Compare the same sampling population with validated classification, contemporaneous controls and documented intervention timing.
Use a prespecified equivalence margin and sufficiently precise machine comparisons if equivalence is the question.
evidence: Machine association p=0.461325; before/after rates 0.0015 and 0.00275 with two-sided p=0.224760.
The report acknowledges the actual engineering change is undocumented and inspection consistency insufficient.

reviews.numerical_check: Recomputed machine chi-square=2.578196, p=0.461325, minimum expected cell=10.5; two-proportion z=-1.213969. Baseline 322/125000=0.002576, sustaining 104/100000=0.00104, no p-chart point flags.
